title: Item:Scroll of Daze
wikitext:
{{Scroll | umd difficulty = 20 | no umd check for = Wlk 1 | minimum level = 1 | spell = Daze (spell) | caster level = 1 | base value = 2pp 5gp | pic = Scroll of Daze.png | vendors = | notes = Casters are unable to cast the spell this scroll confers naturally - the nearest analogue, [[Daze Monster]], applies an extra debuff to Will saves, is a level 2 spell, but is not available to Warlocks. Wizards can not add the spell to their spell book by [[inscribe|inscribing]] this scroll, although '''the scroll and inscription materials will be consumed''' if they try.
Additionally, this scroll can be used in the construction of a [[Trapmaking#Magical_Traps|Daze Trap]]. }}
